name: Craftsman's Writ: Advanced Target Dummy
summary: A customer's transferable writ requests one Advanced Target Dummy and gives the delivery and payment details. It lets you complete the exchange at the marked location.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The note is written in faded ink, and it can pass from one bearer to another. It asks you to bring one Advanced Target Dummy, with the delivery place and payment noted on the writ.

sections.title: The Exchange
sections.body: To complete the exchange, you need the requested item and the writ in your possession. Bring them to the location marked on your map.

aliases: what item does it ask for
faq.answer: The customer requests one Advanced Target Dummy.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the dummy?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ must be in your possession to complete the exchange.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.
